ideal: Every change Claude merges shows its checks, keeps the written rules, ships no bug and lands within a day on few tokens.

sources.title: Anthropic: How the Claude Code team does code review
Google Cloud: Using the Four Keys to measure your DevOps performance

quality: Each merge shows its checks' output and keeps the written rules, no shipped bug stays open, instruction paths resolve, and the CI fence is proven.
speed: A task goes from its first session or commit to merged within a day, at the 90th percentile too.
consumption: A merged change costs fewer Claude Code tokens than an average developer's active day, and the daily read is one short job.
